values.title: Relations
values.summary: Model one-to-many and many-to-many relations and load them in a single query.
values.body:
## One-to-many

A column with `references()` creates a one-to-many relation. The client exposes it in both directions.

TypeScript

```
const project = await db.projects.find(id, {
  with: { tasks: { where: { done: false } } },
})
// project.tasks: Task[]
```

## Many-to-many

Define a join table with two references. Tessera recognises the pattern and adds a `through` helper.

schema.ts

```
export const memberships = table("memberships", {
  userId: uuid().references(() => users.id),
  projectId: uuid().references(() => projects.id),
}).primaryKey("userId", "projectId")
```

## Loading strategy

Nested `with` clauses compile to a single SQL query using lateral joins, so loading relations never causes N+1 requests.

Select less

Combine `with` and `select` to fetch only the columns a view needs.
